units.source_text: 良平跑进村子的时候，街道左右两旁的人家都已经点了灯。

en.t: When Ryohei ran into the village, the houses on both sides of the street had already lit their lamps.

units.source_text: 借着灯光，良平清楚的感觉到自己浑身大汗，汗津津的头上直冒热气。

en.t: By the lamplight, Ryohei could clearly feel that he was drenched in sweat, with steam rising from his clammy head.

units.source_text: 在井边汲水的妇女们，和从田里干完活归来的男人们，

en.t: The women drawing water by the well and the men coming back after finishing their work in the fields,

units.source_text: 看到良平气喘吁吁地跑来，都不由关心的问：“喂，你这是怎么了啊？”

en.t: when they saw Ryohei running up breathlessly, they all could not help asking with concern, “Hey, what happened to you?”

units.source_text: 然而良平却一声不吭，从从杂货店、理发店这些灯火通明的房屋前跑了过去。

en.t: But Ryohei said nothing and ran past the brightly lit houses, including the general store and the barber shop.
